resolution.title: [Smartswitch] Add `SonicDpu` to the type in DEVICE_METADATA yang model
resolution.description:
#### Why I did it
This change is done because the DPUs are initalized with the `SonicDpu` type from sonic-config-engine https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/blob/9b9da85f5072e2b7e6ff3058ab816b73e7cb491c/src/sonic-config-engine/config_samples.py#L148
This is added to the yang models in order to yang validation doesn't fail
Fixes: https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/issues/21111
##### Work item tracking
- Microsoft ADO **(number only)**:

Added `SonicDpu` type in src/sonic-yang-models/tests/yang_model_tests/tests/device_metadata.json
